source: NBA.com stats API, Synergy play types (https://stats.nba.com/stats/synergyplaytypes), the endpoint the public pages https://www.nba.com/stats/players/<playtype> call

columns.total_poss: possessions across all play types, from NBA.com's possession share of each team's largest play type, summed over teams

qualifier: NBA.com lists a player in a play type only with 10+ possessions of it; absent means fewer, not zero
